reviews.review:
♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ exquisite

It'll make you actually care about an Ultramarine
This is a 40k Fans must play at lest once.

(Note: I spent much much more time playing this on PS3 than on Steam)

This game is seriously a must-get for 40k fans. There are many 40k titles on PC these days and most of them excel at portraying one aspect of the universe; Space Marine does an excellent job providing a third person action perspective and in particular the melee and jump pack gameplay is very well done. 

There are lots of little indications that this game was made by people that understood 40k; in the campaign, you only automatically heal a small portion of your health (Which represents your armour); to manually heal yourself you must eviscerate enemies in gory executions. The result of this design choice is that running low on health forces you to play agressive and go for stylish melee kills, rather than hiding behind cover, which is an enjoyable change of pace from other shooters. The general setting of the game, including the design of the enemies and the architecture also shows high fidelity to the 40k universe, although it can be said that the atmospheric walks inbetween fights in singleplayer results in an odd pacing at times.

The big drawback that I'm obliged to mention is that the multiplayer is unfortunately very dead at the moment. That's not to say that you won't find any games at all, but it's an inescapable elephant in the room. In my opinion, the game would actually be worth playing for the singleplayer alone, especially if you catch this game on sale, and there is an excellent PvE gamemode which you only need 2-3 mates or matchmade fellas to play, and is very fun. If you are a 40k fan, especially a CSM, SM or Orky fella, get this game on sale at the very least.
I think this game has a mediocre rating because the multi community is broken, but the game itself is great. Love the hyperviolence.
50 euros for a 13year old game, greed is a bad thing and leads to piracy ;)
